name: Docker Sandboxes (sbx)
description: OpenClaw sandbox backend for Docker's sbx CLI, using native bind-mounted sandbox containers for exec and file tools.

command.label: sbx Command
command.help: Path or command name for the Docker Sandboxes (sbx) CLI.

agent.label: Agent/Kit
agent.help: sbx agent or kit name used when creating a sandbox. Use "shell" for a plain exec sandbox.

template.label: Template
template.help: Optional container image override passed as --template.

pull.label: Pull Policy
pull.help: Image pull policy passed as --pull (always, missing, or never).

timeoutSeconds.label: Command Timeout Seconds
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for sbx CLI operations such as create.
